a1.cap: A signal is a reactive value: reading it in the template subscribes the view, and set/update notify it. computed derives a value from other signals and recalculates only when they change.
No subscriptions, no manual change detection, and it works in zoneless apps.
Components are standalone by default in modern Angular: no NgModule needed.

a1.cap: OnPush plus signals means Angular only re-renders this view when a signal it reads changes.

computed derives parity from count and recalculates only when count changes.
update produces the next value from the previous one.
